module_title: Advanced Analysis - Power Balances, DPSP, and Decentralization
introduction: This advanced level explores the judicial friction caused by the 42nd Amendment, the shifting of subjects to the Concurrent List, and the institutionalization of local bodies through Election and Finance Commissions.

core_concepts.title: Judicial Review Friction (42nd vs 43rd/44th)
core_concepts.description: The 42nd Amendment attempted to reduce the power of the Supreme Court and High Courts regarding Judicial Review and Writs. These powers were mostly restored by the 43rd and 44th Amendments to maintain the Basic Structure.

core_concepts.title: Shifting Subjects (The 42nd Amendment)
core_concepts.description: Moved 5 subjects from the State List to the Concurrent List: 1. Education, 2. Forests, 3. Weights & Measures, 4. Protection of Wild Animals/Birds, 5. Administration of Justice (excluding SC/HC).

core_concepts.title: New DPSPs (42nd Amendment)
core_concepts.description: Added Article 39A (Equal justice and free legal aid), Article 43A (Participation of workers in management), and Article 48A (Protection of environment/forests/wildlife).

core_concepts.title: Institutional Decentralization (73rd/74th)
core_concepts.description: Mandated the creation of two constitutional bodies in every state: 1. State Election Commission (for local polls) and 2. State Finance Commission (for revenue sharing). It also mandated 1/3rd reservation for women.

important_entities.name: Minerva Mills Case (1980)
important_entities.significance: The 42nd gave DPSP absolute primacy over Fundamental Rights. The SC struck this down, ruling that the Constitution exists on a 'harmony' between the two.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Did you know the word 'Cabinet' was not in the original Constitution? It was only inserted into Article 352 by the 44th Amendment Act (1978).
The 42nd Amendment increased the Lok Sabha tenure from 5 to 6 years. The 44th Amendment brought it back down to 5 years.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: E-F-W-W-A (Education, Forests, Weights, Wildlife, Admin of Justice)
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: A quick way to recall the 5 subjects moved from the State to Concurrent List.

exam_strategy_tips: In Assertion-Reasoning questions, check if the statement links the 'Basic Structure' to the restoration of judicial powers by the 44th Amendment.
Remember that State Election Commissions are independent of the Election Commission of India (ECI). They conduct local body polls, while ECI conducts MP/MLA polls.
